editor.das-wird-erst-mit: This only takes effect with “Save folder type”.
editor.mappen-haben-in-einen_one: {anzahl} folder has a value in “{label}”. The values stay saved but are no longer shown.{ERST_BEIM_SPEICHERN}
editor.mappen-haben-in-einen_other: {anzahl} folders have a value in “{label}”. The values stay saved but are no longer shown.{ERST_BEIM_SPEICHERN}
editor.kopie-von-noch-nicht: Copy of “{name}” – not saved yet. Folders are not copied.
editor.neuen-mappentyp-mit-feldern: Create a new folder type with the fields, title, result lists, tabs and permissions of this folder type
editor.systemmappentyp-jeder-benutzer-ha: System folder type: every user has their folder here. You can add fields and tabs; the system fields are fixed and are maintained in the profile and in user management. Creating and deleting only happens in user management.
editor.systemmappentyp-rollen-die-benutz: System folder type: roles that users can have. You can add fields and tabs; the system field is fixed. Administrator and Member are system roles and can’t be deleted.
editor.mappen-passen-nicht-zur_one: {anzahl} folder doesn’t match the current definition. It is marked in the library.
editor.mappen-passen-nicht-zur_other: {anzahl} folders don’t match the current definition. They are marked in the library.
editor.name: Name
editor.fest-name-laesst-sich: fixed – the name can change, links stay valid
editor.wofuer-ist-dieser-mappentyp: What is this folder type for?
editor.abwaehlen-wenn-die-mappen: Untick if the folders should appear in an existing view – you set that under Workbench → Views.
editor.eigene-ansicht-in-der: Create its own view in the library{klein}
editor.kann-aus-post-hilfe: Then it can be chosen under “Where does this belong?” when taking over post – for everyone who may create folders here. Default: on, because the type has a documents tab.
editor.kann-aus-post-ohne-register: Then it can be chosen under “Where does this belong?” when taking over post – for everyone who may create folders here. Default: off, because the type has no documents tab.
editor.woran-erkennt-beispiel: e.g. Contains invoice number, amount and payment deadline; the sender is a contract partner
editor.woran-erkennt-hilfe_one: A short sentence that helps recognition tell which folder type suits a document. {anzahl} character left.
editor.woran-erkennt-hilfe_other: A short sentence that helps recognition tell which folder type suits a document. {anzahl} characters left.
editor.feld-anklicken-um-feldart: Click a field to set its field kind and properties. The order also applies in the form; change it with the arrows or by dragging the handle ⠿. {hilfe}
editor.noch-keine-felder-fuege: No fields yet. Add the first one, for example “Description” as text.
editor.im-archivmodus-nicht-moeglich: Not possible in archive mode – post for this type is only assigned by hand.
editor.sicher-heisst-absender-eindeutig: Certain means: sender recognised unambiguously (e.g. customer number, IBAN) and exactly one matching folder of this type. The recipient gets the task “Assigned automatically – please check” with undo. Ablago never creates new folders by itself.
editor.post-automatisch-zuordnen-wenn: Assign post automatically when recognition is certain{klein}
editor.nirgends-verwendet-keine-ansicht: Not used anywhere – no view shows it, no other folder type links to it.
editor.mehrere-werte-gleichzeitig-waehlb: Several values can be chosen at once
editor.wird-verschluesselt-gespeichert-u: Stored encrypted and never appears in the title, the result list, the search or demo data. It can only be shown individually via the eye; that is recorded in the history.
editor.verweist-auf-mappen-vom: Links to folders of the folder types
editor.dieser-mappentyp-ergibt-eine: “This folder type” creates a hierarchy, e.g. heating → house.
editor.z-b-eine-zahlung: e.g. one payment for several invoices
editor.einen-auswahlfilter-auf-diesen: You can set a selection filter on this folder type itself after saving for the first time.
editor.folgt-aus-hilfe: When a folder is chosen there, this field is filled from it – only if it’s empty. You can always enter something else by hand.
editor.folgt-aus-kein-ziel: The folders there have no reference field to the same folder type.
editor.vorbelegen-hilfe: When a folder is chosen, Ablago suggests its details in empty fields of this folder – clearly marked and editable. Nothing is overwritten, passwords never, and only what the person may read.
editor.vorbelegen-passt-nicht: These fields do not (or no longer) fit together – the pair is skipped.
editor.nummernkreis-das-feld-wird: Number sequence – the field becomes read-only
editor.systemfeld-bezeichnung-hilfetext-: System field: label, help text and tab can be changed; field kind and properties are fixed.
editor.erklaerung-die-beim-ausfuellen: Explanation that appears while filling in
editor.mappe-laesst-sich-ohne: The folder can’t be saved without a value
editor.wert-darf-je-mappentyp: The value may occur only once per folder type
editor.aus-dokument-fuellen-hilfe: “Fill in from document” enters this value from a photo or document as a suggestion.
editor.zum-wiederfinden-hilfe: If this value is in a document, Ablago finds the matching folder again – e.g. customer number, contract number, invoice number or registration number. Independent of “Unique”.
editor.zum-wiederfinden-verweis: If the folder this field links to is found in the document, that also counts for this folder – e.g. a contract via its contract partner.
editor.z-b-kundennummer-oben: e.g. customer number top right, pattern 100-####
editor.so-heisst-eine-mappe: This is what a folder is called in lists and links. Fields in curly brackets are filled in; everything else stays as it is.
editor.indexwert-datum-an-dem: Index value {{k}}: date on which the folder was {wert}
editor.diese-platzhalter-passen-zu: These placeholders don’t match any field:
editor.hinter-einem-senkrechten-strich: After a vertical bar, several in a row too: {code}. If a field is empty, it drops out together with separators such as “ – ” or “ · ”.
editor.auf-diesem-register-liegen: There are fields on this tab, and there is no other field tab. Create another one first.
editor.enthaelt-es-noch-dokumente: If it still contains documents, the folder type can’t be saved.
editor.die-trennblaetter-einer-mappe: The dividers of a folder, in this order. Which fields are on which field tab you set on the field.
editor.hier-werden-dateien-hochgeladen: Files are uploaded here; PDFs and images can be viewed directly.
editor.textebene-von-pdfs-lesen: Read the text layer of PDFs and send scanned pages and images through text recognition so that the full-text search finds them.
editor.beim-ersetzen-bleibt-die: When replacing, the old version is kept and can be brought back.
editor.zeigt-wer-wann-was: Shows who changed what on the folder and when – one entry per save with all changed fields, plus documents, bin, notes, tasks, emails and retrievals. Entries can’t be changed.
editor.historie-zeigt-hinweis: (everything is always recorded; “in administration mode” is always shown)
editor.noch-verweist-kein-verweisfeld: No link field points to this folder type yet. The tab shows all links as soon as there are any.
editor.keine-auswahl-alle-als: (no selection = all, as a simple list; for a table choose the source and a result list)
editor.zeigt-mappen-die-so: Shows folders that link here like this {span}
editor.sie-wird-an-stellen_one: It is used in one place; the default list then applies there.
editor.sie-wird-an-stellen_other: It is used in {anzahl} places; the default list then applies there.
editor.spalten-wenn-die-liste: Columns, when the list is wide enough, in this order. In narrow windows the first three form the compact entry: the first in bold, the second and third below. Without columns: title and two fields. One list is the default; views and links tabs can choose another.
editor.eine-trefferliste-braucht-der: A folder type always needs one result list
editor.gilt-ueberall-wo-keine: Applies everywhere no other list is chosen.
editor.fuer-belege-mit-aufbewahrungspfli: For records with a retention obligation: until the end of the period no folder and no document can be deleted – not even by administrators; documents only change as a new version. Afterwards the folders appear under Workbench → Retention expired. Nothing is ever deleted automatically. This supports retention in line with GoBD, but doesn’t replace process documentation or tax advice.
editor.danach-lassen-sich-mappen: Afterwards, folders and documents of this folder type can be deleted before the end of the period again. This is recorded in the log.
editor.gilt-auch-fuer-vorhandene: Also applies to existing folders. Versioning of the documents tabs then becomes mandatory.
editor.frist-bis-ende-des: Period until the end of the calendar year + years
editor.leer-laeuft-nicht-hinweis: The folder stays locked until “{feld}” is filled in – for example for a running contract or the current version. Only then does the period start.
editor.leer-anzahl-ab-anlage_one: For 1 folder “{feld}” is empty – the creation date counts there.
editor.leer-anzahl-ab-anlage_other: For {anzahl} folders “{feld}” is empty – the creation date counts there.
editor.leer-anzahl-laeuft-nicht_one: For 1 folder “{feld}” is empty – the period isn’t running there yet.
editor.leer-anzahl-laeuft-nicht_other: For {anzahl} folders “{feld}” is empty – the period isn’t running there yet.
editor.davon-waeren-schon-darf_one: , of which 1 would already be “may go”
editor.davon-waeren-schon-darf_other: , of which {anzahl} would already be “may go”
editor.in-jeder-mappe-dieses: In every folder of this type: take a photo or choose a file, and recognition enters the details into the fields as a suggestion.
editor.knopf-aus-dokument-ausfuellen: Show the “Fill in from document” button{klein}
editor.kein-feld-aus-dokument: No field has “Fill from document” – then “Fill in from document” fills all fields whose kind follows from the label (e.g. “Email”, “Phone”, “Postcode”). You can set it on each field.
editor.wiederfinden-ueber: Ablago finds existing folders again via: {felder}.
editor.kein-feld-wiederfinden: No field has “Use to find existing folders” – then Ablago doesn't find existing folders of this type in documents.
editor.pflicht-dokumente-dieses-mappenty: Required: documents of this folder type only leave Ablago stamped – when downloading, in exports (PDF, ZIP), by email and via the API. Documents that aren’t PDFs or images then can’t be passed on.
editor.vorschlag-beim-weitergeben-ist: Suggestion: when passing on, “With stamp” is already ticked, with this template; it can be unticked.
editor.kein-stempel-vorgegeben-benutzer: No stamp preset; users can still choose one when passing on.
beschriftung.optionen-hilfe: The value on the left is what’s saved. The label is shown in the user’s language; without a label, the value itself. A changed label leaves the saved folders unchanged.
darstellung.noch-genutzt: This is still used: {liste}. Hidden, it stays as it is there – you just won’t see it in the folder any more. The values are kept.
darstellung.pflicht-aufgehoben-ansage: No longer required: {felder}. Hidden fields can’t be required.
darstellung.pflicht-aufgehoben: No longer required – hidden fields can’t be required.
berechnet.aktiv: The package {paket} calculates the value. In the folder the field is read-only; only the package writes it – through the interface, with its rights.
berechnet.nicht-mehr: The package {paket} no longer calculates this field. The last value stays and the field remains read-only – until you release it.
berechnet.wird-freigegeben: Released when you save – after that the value can be changed in the folder again.
berechnet.nie-pflicht: Calculated fields are never required – the package writes the value.
darstellung.ausblenden-hilfe: Not shown in the folder and not offered for new columns and conditions. Saved values are kept.
darstellung.register-ausgeblendet: The tab is hidden – so this field is too.
darstellung.register-ausblenden-hilfe: The folder doesn’t show the tab; its fields count as hidden, their values are kept.
darstellung.register-ausblenden-hilfe-2: The folder doesn’t show the tab.
darstellung.aufteilung-hilfe: Sections start a new row. With a heading the folder shows a thin line and the title, collapsed if you like; without a heading just the line break.
darstellung.ohne-ueberschrift: No heading: just a new row
darstellung.eingeklappt-nur-mit-titel: Only sections with a heading can be collapsed.
editor.negativ-hilfe: For credit notes and refunds; the form then shows “Enter it with a minus”.
editor.zeitraum-hilfe: A whole number and a unit (days, weeks, months, years), for example “3 months”. Sorted by length.
anzeige.immer: Always shown. With a condition the folder only shows it when the condition applies – values stay saved.
anzeige.verweistyp: Reference points to a folder of type …
editor.ziele-offen: (target type from another package, not installed yet)
editor.mehrere-ziele-hilfe: Several types: when filling in, the folders are offered grouped by type, e.g. “concerns” vehicle, flat or contract.
editor.gleicher-typ-hilfe: If the first folder chosen is a vehicle, the others may only be vehicles.
editor.ziele-optional: Added as soon as it is installed: {typen}
tabelle.typ-hilfe: Folder types with a link field pointing to this type – as for a links tab.
tabelle.feld: that link here through this field
tabelle.feld-hilfe: For example “Invoice” on the invoice item.
tabelle.liste-hilfe: Columns and order as in this results list of the other type; never password fields.
tabelle.neu-hilfe: Shown below the table, for example “+ Item”. Only people who may create the other type see the button.
tabelle.ohne-wert: A table has no value of its own: it only shows the folders – not in exports, not in conditions, without totals.
tabelle.keine-quelle: No field links to this type yet. First add a link field pointing to this type in the other folder type (for example “Invoice” on the invoice item).
teile.einstellung-hilfe: Folders of this type always belong to another folder, e.g. invoice items to their invoice. They only appear there – not in views, search and "+ New".
teile.hat-teile: Not possible: folders of this type have parts themselves ({typen}).
teile.kein-feld: This needs a link field to exactly one other folder type that holds one folder.
teile.feld-hilfe: The link field to the parent folder. It becomes required.
teile.bedeutet: New folders are created at the parent folder ({eltern}), e.g. through a table or a linked folders tab. The type has no view of its own; search finds what is in a folder at {eltern}. If a folder of the type {eltern} is deleted, its parts go with it.
teile.rechte: Read permissions: without permissions of its own, the type takes over the read permissions of {eltern} once when you switch this on. If the permissions of {eltern} change later, that does not apply here by itself – otherwise parts could be readable more widely than their folder; please adjust them here too.
teile.kein-schutz: No protection: parts are missing from views and search but remain reachable through the API, the export and direct links. Who may see what is set by the permissions.
teile.rechte-uebernommen: Read permissions taken over from {eltern} – see Permissions.
teile.rechte-ausgelassen_one: {anzahl} rule could not be carried over (its field is missing here) – please check yourself.
teile.rechte-ausgelassen_other: {anzahl} rules could not be carried over (their field is missing here) – please check yourself.
